name: Digarr
description: AI-powered music discovery engine for self-hosted music stacks. Connects to Lidarr, Last.fm, ListenBrainz, Spotify, and more to find new artists you will actually like. Supports auto-playlists, subscription feeds, mood-based discovery, and genre browsing. Ships with a built-in embedded database -- no separate PostgreSQL container needed. Data is stored in the mapped data folder (/mnt/user/appdata/digarr/data), which must be writable by the container user (uid 1000). To use an external PostgreSQL instead, set the (advanced) Database URL variable.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the built-in embedded database. Must be writable by the container user (uid 1000).

variables.name: Data Path
variables.description: Container path for the built-in embedded database (matches the Data folder mapping)

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Leave empty to use the built-in database. Set only to use an external PostgreSQL, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/digarr

variables.name: Initial Username
variables.description: Auto-create this admin user on first boot

variables.name: Initial Password
variables.description: Password for the initial admin user (min 8 chars)

variables.name: AI Provider
variables.description: AI provider: anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama, openai-compatible (or configure in UI)

variables.name: AI API Key
variables.description: API key for the AI provider

variables.name: AI Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for openai-compatible or ollama (e.g. http://ollama:11434)

variables.name: Lidarr URL
variables.description: Lidarr instance URL, e.g. http://lidarr:8686 (optional -- discovery works without Lidarr)

variables.name: Lidarr API Key
variables.description: Lidarr API key (Settings > General in Lidarr)

variables.name: Allowed Origin
variables.description: CORS allowed origin, e.g. https://digarr.example.com (required for reverse proxy)

variables.name: Encryption Key
variables.description: 32+ char key for encrypting stored API tokens (auto-generated if blank)

variables.name: Disable Registration
variables.description: Set to false to allow new user registration

variables.name: Skip TLS Verify
variables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Lidarr/Jellyfin connections

variables.name: Webhook URL
variables.description: Discord, Slack, ntfy, or any HTTP endpoint for notifications
